name: Language learning
why: Communicate confidently in the language I'm learning
motivation: A week of daily practice and you won't notice any difference. Two weeks and you start to feel some difference. A month of every single day and you'll be a changed person.

name: Communication
why: Present ideas clearly and confidently to any audience
facets: Practice a 30-second summary of something I did
Frame a problem with proposed solutions
Rehearse answering a hard question simply

name: Soft skills
why: Handle people and pressure the way the people I admire do
facets: Notice and name emotions in the moment
Reflect on one situation handled well or badly
Observe how someone effective speaks and acts

name: Exercise
why: Stay healthy and energetic for everything else

name: Domain knowledge
why: Deepen the technical foundations behind my work
